architecture: Native iOS-only SwiftUI app, iOS 17+, Swift package CentreCore for Codable domain, atomic workspace-scoped disk cache, durable idempotent pending changes, optimistic concurrency and conflict handling. URLSession HTTPS calls to database-owner Worker only. Keychain credentials. No local desktop endpoint/runtime requirement.
domain: Generic Centre records/changes protocol. CloudRecord.version is transport CAS; data.revision is canonical domain revision. Optional createdCursor is retained and sorts equal-createdAt messages numerically; legacy positions are retained. Unknown kinds/data stay in the cache. No generated search/private execution/credentials sync.
studyLog: Reuse study-log v1 StudySession and WeeklyStudyGoal exact fields. Persist UTC segments, Monday/IANA goals, 15s checkpoint/45s lease, pause at saved checkpoint on restart/import/background, no closed-app timer credit, idle10min/check-in60min, optimistic revisions/tombstones. No planned-calendar-to-study-time conversion.
offline: Read cached resources/chats/calendar/review; quiz practice, timer/manual log, goals and edits persist atomically before network. Durable outbox ID reused on retries. Never silently overwrite conflicts. Cache partitioned by account/workspace; logout removes credentials and local private data with pending-change warning. Synchronize on launch/foreground/manual retry, no guaranteed iOS background execution.

Connection credentials entered on phone sent only to encrypted hosted connector, never cached.
attachments: Read-only authenticated metadata/chunks with ?chatId=activeTarget. Server canonical ancestry gate uses all persisted chats/messages including archived ancestors. Mobile active association required. Size/chunk/base64/SHA256 verified before atomic publication, 20MiB/file and100MiB cache, partition by server/workspace/target. MIME-based safe extensions; cached reading offline; sign-out invalidates/erases actors.
